title: invitations: a delegated_admin's Invite User dialog offers the Owner and Admin roles the server then refuses — sys_invitation.role options are static, and no contract tells the client which roles the caller may grant
body:
**Filing gate ①** — a user-visible defect at a public surface, measured. **`reach:`** on the stock showcase (objectstack `2034975a`, console at `.objectui-sha` `daeb77fc`), a `delegated_admin` opens Invite User and the role picker offers Owner and Admin; choosing either, the server refuses the invitation (the role-cap refusal — its missing `code` is #23945). The form offers values the caller can never submit.

**Found by** objectstack's full platform-checklist run (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878), identity-auth slice — report comment 6216631966 on #23878, record objectstack-ai/objectstack#23943 — where the runner listed it as an unfiled observation. **Filed by** the objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (objectstack seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`, on the maintainer's pointer that reported problems were left unfiled. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the seat triage routes it to. The landing is a contract question before it is a UI one: per the filing gate a UI fix must name the spec contract it reads, and none exists today.

## Where (objectstack origin/main)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts:250-256`: `role: Field.select({ … options: [...BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_OPTIONS] … })` — one static list for every caller.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-cap.ts` (referenced from `adopt-membership.ts:98`): the server-side cap that refuses `owner` / `admin` from a delegated issuer.
- The client renders the declared options; it has nothing that says which of them this caller may grant.

## Direction (for the reader to measure, not a ruling)

The server already decides the cap, so the answer belongs with it: either a declared, reusable way for a select field's offered values to be narrowed per caller, or the invite action declaring its grantable roles for the caller. #21795 (closed) is the action-level sibling of this class ("a plain member is offered Invite User … that the server then refuses"); this card is the option-level one. A new platform contract would be the reader's decision to raise, not this card's.

## Done when

- A `delegated_admin`'s invite dialog offers only the roles that issuer may grant; an owner or admin still sees all of them.
- A pin asserts the offered set for both callers and fails against today's static list.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing: `invite user dialog offers owner admin roles to delegated admin server refuses invitation role cap options per caller` → 5 hits: #23945 (open — the refusal's missing `code`, same flow, different defect), #21795 (closed, action-level sibling), #8240, #8092, #3697 (closed, other invitation defects). None is this.

Dedupe words: invite role picker offers refused roles; delegated_admin invitation role options; per-caller select options.
